raw_comment:
What do you notice?
I noticed all of America seems to be in dry condition except for Florida and Alaska which seems to be normal.
What do you wonder?
I wonder if there is one main problem that has caused everything to be dry. I wonder what has caused Florida and Alaska, two very different states, to not be dry.
How does this relate to you and your community?
Will I notice that the majority of Michigan is at least moderately dry? I want to know how this is being measured as I live in Michigan and could be affected by this potential drought.
Create a catchy headline that captures the graph’s main idea.
Hey US, Why So Dry?
